meta_description:
380 likes, 97 comments - archanaskitchen on April 14, 2026: "It’s finally here… and I’m holding it in my hands ❤️

After months (and honestly, years) of dreaming, testing, writing, and cooking- this book has come to life. Every page carries a piece of my kitchen, my experiences, and the meals I’ve loved sharing with family and friends.

This isn’t just a cookbook for me. It’s a reflection of everyday cooking made joyful, practical, and full of flavor - just the way I believe food should be.

If you’ve ever cooked from my recipes, trusted my meal plans, or simply followed along on this journey… this book is for you.

You can now order your copy ✨
👉 Link is in bio
@weldonowen 

I cannot wait for this book to find a place in your kitchen, be cooked from, scribbled on, and loved.

Do share it with someone who enjoys good food as much as you do - and when you cook from it, I would LOVE to see what you make 💛

#NewBook #CookbookLaunch #IndianCooking #EverydayCooking #HomeCooking FromMyKitchenToYours".
